changes: Fixed the actual root cause of the chat scroll bug, found via live DevTools inspection rather than another theory. The message list was a flex container with justify-content:flex-end while ALSO being the scrollable element — a real, documented browser quirk that can make overflow at the top of a flex-end-aligned scroll container genuinely unreachable by scrolling.
Casino Pot now pays out twice a month (1st & 16th, 8am AEST) instead of once — smaller, more regular payouts, split 75% evenly among everyone eligible / 25% single jackpot.
Casino Pot payouts no longer count toward Player Tier — only genuine game wins, tipping results, and board results move your tier now.
Fixed Slots' gamble feature (Red/Black, suit picks, Collect) getting stuck unresponsive after a win.
